films.title: Safety Last!
films.overview: When a store clerk organizes a contest to climb the outside of a tall building, circumstances force him to make the perilous climb himself.

films.title: Girl Shy
films.overview: Harold Meadows is a shy, stuttering bachelor working in a tailor shop, who is writing a guidebook, The Secret of Making Love, for other bashful young men. Fate has him meet rich girl Mary, and they fall in love. But she is about to wed an already married man, so our hero embarks upon a hair-raising daredevil ride to prevent the wedding.

films.title: The Freshman
films.overview: An unathletic college freshman ridiculed by his peers for his mannerisms strives to become popular by making the football team.
